description: This file contains benchmark classes and functions for testing lithium-ion battery simulations using the liionpack and pybamm libraries. It defines classes for different pack sizes and benchmarking methods for solving models and discharging batteries with varying computational resources.

classes.name: BasicBenchmark
classes.description: Benchmark class for basic simulation timing.

classes.name: SmallPack
classes.description: Benchmark class for small battery pack simulation and discharge timing.

classes.name: MediumPack
classes.description: Benchmark class for medium battery pack simulation and discharge timing.

classes.name: LargePack
classes.description: Benchmark class for large battery pack simulation, discharge, and long cycle timing.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes simulation parameters and circuits for each benchmark class.

methods.name: time_solve_model
methods.description: Times the model solving process in BasicBenchmark.

methods.name: time_discharge_1cpu
methods.description: Times battery discharge using 1 CPU in SmallPack, MediumPack, and LargePack.

methods.name: time_discharge_2cpu
methods.description: Times battery discharge using 2 CPUs in SmallPack, MediumPack, and LargePack.

methods.name: time_long_cycle_2cpu
methods.description: Times a long cycle simulation with 2 CPUs in LargePack.
